observations: Two physical game cases for the PlayStation 4 console.
A PEGI 18 age rating is visible on the bottom left of the covers.
The Warner Bros. Games logo is visible on the bottom right of the covers.
The cases appear to be wrapped in clear plastic shrink-wrap.
The background consists of stacked cardboard shipping boxes.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PREMIUM GADGETS' is visible across the center.

claims.claim: Mortal Kombat is a fighting game in which players battle opponents in one-on-one matches.
claims.evidence: The title and cover art in photo 0 are consistent with the Mortal Kombat fighting game franchise.

risks.risk: The disc may be missing or damaged despite the external wrap.
risks.proof: A photo of the open case showing the disc surface.

risks.risk: The shrink-wrap may be a third-party reseal rather than factory original, meaning the game is used.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the top or bottom edge showing the factory 'Y-fold' seal.

risks.risk: The game region may not match the buyer's account for DLC purposes.
risks.proof: A photo of the spine or the back of the case showing the CUSA code and region globe icon.
risks.if_unproven: as the standard local region copy

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the game case.
Photo of the open case showing the disc.
Close-up photo of the seal edges to verify if it is factory original.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as Mortal Kombat 11 for PS4. It can be priced at its worst case as a used, non-working copy until the disc and seal are verified.
